title: Avalanche — mother's prayer (Blues 9679 prototype)

characters.climber: a young man with short blonde hair and blue eyes in a black ski tracksuit
characters.mom: an older woman with grey hair and blue eyes in a maroon knit cardigan
characters.rescuer: a mountain rescuer with dark hair and brown eyes in a red rescue jacket
characters.prayer: a small warm glowing golden orb of light

world: Pixar-style 3D animated film, cinematic volumetric lighting, highly detailed, snowy mountain, consistent character design, no text or captions
_design_note: LOW-MOTION by design (free LTX breaks on motion): people are STILL (stand/kneel/brace/lie/gaze), never running; motion comes from snow/powder/light/orb + slow camera. BURIAL CONTINUITY: once buried (shot 15) he stays buried, only face/hand visible in packed snow, until dug out (shot 34) and lifted out (shot 36). ONE rescuer only. No morphing. See [[project-ai-video-shot-design]].
shots: Sweeping aerial of a vast snowy mountain with a twin-peaked summit at dawn, soft pink light on the peaks, slow drifting camera
Far below on the slope, a tiny lone climber stands paused on a snowy ridge, dwarfed by the huge mountain, slow push-in
The young climber kneels still on the snowy ridge gripping his silver ice axe, cold breath misting in the air, slow tilt up
Extreme close-up of the blonde young man's frosted face and bright blue eyes, calm and determined, snowflakes drifting past, gentle push-in
The young man stands still on the ridge gazing up at the towering twin-peaked summit, tiny against the huge peak, slow zoom out
A cozy lamplit living room: the grey-haired grandmother in a maroon cardigan sits watching a TV showing the snowy mountain on the news, worried, slow push-in
Close on the grandmother's face, eyes gently closing, hands clasped to her chest in prayer, warm amber light, slow push-in
A small warm golden orb of light rises softly from the praying grandmother's chest, glowing gently in the dim room, slow lift
The golden orb of light floats out through the window into the night sky trailing soft sparkles, slow follow
High on the mountain a long jagged crack sits frozen across the snowfield above, ominous and silent, slow push
A towering wall of snow, an avalanche, pours and churns down the mountainside, immense billowing powder, wide slow shot
The young man stands frozen and tiny on the ridge as the churning wall of snow bears down, slow motion
The young man crouched low and braced behind a large dark boulder, curled tight, churning snow and powder rushing past him, slow motion
Whiteout: swirling churning snow powder engulfs the whole frame, soft and blinding, slow
Buried under the snow: only the young man's faint blue-lit face is visible in a small dark air pocket, packed snow all around, eyes open, held still
Close-up under the snow: the young man's gloved hand pressed weakly against the dense packed snow above him, no give, faint blue light, still
Far above, the golden orb of light drifts across the night sky over jagged moonlit peaks, slow aerial follow
The orb of light drifts higher toward a faint warm glow on the horizon where the sun will rise, vast starlit sky, slow drift
Buried in the dark, a faint warm golden glow flickers softly inside the young man's chest, fragile, slow push-in
Extreme close-up buried in snow: the young man's blue eyes half-closed, a single frozen tear on his cheek, packed snow around his face, still
Wide of the silent white mountain face under the night sky, no sign of life, cold and still, slow drift
A single tiny rescuer in a red jacket stands far up the snowy slope holding a long pole, distant and small, slow push
The bearded mountain rescuer in the red jacket stands scanning the snow, breath fogging, slow pan
Buried in the dark, the young man's gloved hand goes still in the packed snow, the faint inner glow dimming, slow
The golden orb of light merges softly into the rising sun, blazing radiant gold, glowing brighter, slow
The sun swells with warm golden light, radiant rays spreading across the whole white mountain, slow radiant push
Golden sunlight pours over the snowy slope, the cold blue world turning warm, slow sweep
Buried in near-total darkness, only the young man's faint still face remains visible in the packed snow, held motionless
A ski pole pierces straight down through the snow from above and a thin needle of golden sunlight breaks into the dark air pocket, slow
The thin beam of golden sunlight touches the buried young man's face in the dark and his blue eyes flicker open, slow push-in
Buried, the young man's gloved hand reaches slowly up toward the small hole of light above him, straining, low angle
The bearded rescuer kneels over the hole scooping snow away, bright powder flying up, warm golden light, slow push
The rescuer digs at the widening hole, snow powder flying up in the golden light, slow wide
The hole widens and golden sunlight floods down onto the young man's buried face and black tracksuit, relief, slow push-in
Close-up: the rescuer's hand gently clasps the young man's hand in the snow, warm golden light glowing behind them, slow
The blonde young man is drawn up out of the snow into full golden sunlight, gasping and alive, slow rise
The young man lies still in the bright sunlit snow breathing softly under the warm sun, blue sky above, slow overhead drift
The small golden orb of light descends gently from the sun and settles warmly over the resting young man, slow lower
Back home, the grey-haired grandmother opens her eyes with a tear and a soft warm smile, warm light, slow push-in
Final wide: the sunlit snowy mountain at peace under a golden dawn, one tiny safe figure on the slope, slow pull-back
